title: forge test data
description: Payload of `forge test --json`. Without `--expect` this is the replay of the recorded fixtures (`run`'s shape). With `--expect` it also reports whether the replayed output matched the expected file.

anyOf.title: no fixtures
anyOf.description: Nothing to replay and the default fixture path does not exist; `error.type` is `io` and the suggestion is the `--record` invocation.

fixtures.description: Fixture path that was looked for (`--fixtures`, or `<file>.fixtures.json`).

output.description: Every `say` line the replay produced, in order.

result.description: The program's return value, or `null` when it returned nothing (`Unit`).

anyOf.title: replay with --expect
anyOf.description: The comparison runs the replay in a child process in human mode; its stdout is this `output`.

expect.description: File the output was compared against.

matched.description: `false` makes the envelope an error (`error.type` is `runtime`) and exits 1.

anyOf.title: blocked
anyOf.description: Static checks failed before the replay started.
